assets.name: food
assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. The reference is the game's existing dark slate-and-brass resource bar. Deliver one isolated resource symbol ONLY as a transparent PNG. Preserve the selected symbol's silhouette, warm gold/brown palette, painted Warcraft-style highlights, and compact readable proportions. Remove ALL slate/black rectangular backdrop, frame, border, text, numbers, baseline, pedestal, and detached cast shadow. Real transparent alpha, never a checkerboard drawn in the pixels. Center the symbol in a square canvas; symbol should occupy about 85% of the canvas height and be readable at 28–32px. No scene, no UI panel, no lettering. Crisp edges and broad coherent details; avoid extra ornamentation. Extract/recreate ONLY the tied bundle of golden wheat at the far left of the reference. Keep its stems, bound bundle and wheat ears. Nothing else.

assets.name: gold
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated in-game gold currency HUD icon. Reference image: existing gold bars, for color, materials and rendering style only. Create a single gold coin, nearly front-facing with a slight tilt and a visible thin dark bronze edge on the bottom right. One bold raised concentric rim and one simple embossed four-point motif on the face. Use warm amber-gold with bright upper-left highlights, antique bronze shadows, and the reference's softly painted fantasy strategy art. Clean round silhouette distinct at 16 pixels, with broad forms and restrained detail. Center the coin on a square canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. No words, letters, numbers, piles, bars, other objects, background, frame, or detached shadow.
assets.preparation: Centered the transparent cutout at 64×64 and baked a 32×32 runtime WebP.

assets.name: culture
assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one standalone game HUD resource icon. The reference is the game's dark slate-and-brass resource bar; match the warm gold, bronze, detailed but compact painted Warcraft-style resource symbols. Create a small OPEN BOOK with cream parchment pages, warm dark brown binding and restrained gold edges, a clear central spine and two readable page masses. It represents culture/knowledge and replaces the old stone monument symbol. No text, no runes, no page lettering, no icons on the pages. Centered, square canvas, book occupies about 85% width. Designed to read clearly at 28–32px, strong simple silhouette. Genuinely transparent background with transparent alpha. No dark square, slate tile, frame, border, pedestal, detached shadow, UI, numbers or scenery.

assets.name: science
assets.prompt: Make a single transparent-background game UI icon for the Science resource in a historical pixel-art strategy game. A squat transparent glass laboratory BEAKER with a straight cylindrical body, broad open elliptical rim and a small pouring spout on the upper right, half-filled with luminous mint-turquoise liquid. One ivory reflection along the glass, one or two tiny measurement ticks, a dark warm-charcoal outline and warm pale brass-ivory rim highlights that read on walnut and slate UI panels. Front-facing, with just enough elevated viewpoint to see the pouring lip and liquid surface. The final viewport is only 12 to 24 pixels: use extremely simple bold clusters, a broad, instant-read outline, and no tiny decorations. Render as deliberate chunky hand-pixeled 24×24-style art blown up with hard pixel edges. Center the isolated object, large and upright, in a square canvas with a small transparent margin. Just one icon, no lettering or numerals, frame, drop shadow, pedestal, floating decorations or backdrop. True alpha transparency.
assets.preparation: Cropped the generated transparent margin and downsampled to a 28×28 PNG for the in-game HUD and panels.
